source.author: lucan
source.text: Nec non Iliacae numen quod praesidet Albae, Haud meritum Latio sollemnia sacra subacto, Vidit flammifera confectas nocte Latinas.
source.text_original: Nec non Iliacae numen quod praesidet Albae, / Haud meritum Latio sollemnia sacra subacto, / Vidit flammifera confectas nocte Latinas.
source.text_english: Nor did the deity that presides over Ilian Alba, a ritual not deserved by conquered Latium, fail to see the Latins brought low by the fire-bringing night.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Prima deum magnis canimus freta pervia natis fatidicamque ratem, Scythici quae Phasidis oras ausa sequi mediosque inter iuga concita cursus rumpere flammifero tandem consedit Olympo.
reuse.text_original: Prima deum magnis canimus freta pervia natis / fatidicamque ratem, Scythici quae Phasidis oras / ausa sequi mediosque inter iuga concita cursus / rumpere flammifero tandem consedit Olympo.
reuse.text_english: First we sing of the sea passages made traversable by the great sons of the gods, and of the prophetic ship, which, daring to follow the Scythian shores of Phasis and, driven on, to break through its course amid the middle mountain ridges, at last settled on fiery Olympus.
